descriptions.inProgress: I received #t4031704# from the broker. I was told to give it to #p2111001# and answer the questions in the order that the broker told me in order to become a member of Alcadno... I better remember the sequences that #p2111007# gave me when I go see #p2111001#.
descriptions.completed: After a number of tough, tough questions, #p2111001# finally accepted me as a member of Alcadno. Flashing his trademark glass eye as he gave me #t1102136#, the head of the Alcadno Society may look intimidating, but he's a really nice person.
